title: Derived mate on the complex of neighbourhood sections
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a scheme morphism, $s:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to S$ a geometric point, $K\in D^+(\operatorname{Ab}(X_{et}))$, $n\in\mathbf Z$, $J$ a bounded-below complex of injective abelian etale sheaves on $X$, and $q:K\cong QJ$. Let $Q$ be the strict-local neighbourhood geometry [def-weil-pbc-strict-local-neighbourhood-geometry], with stage projections $t_i$ and cone legs $a_i$, and write $p:X\times_S S_{(s)}\to X$. Put $M=\iota J$, $L=f_*M$, and $r:Rf_*K\cong QL$ equal to sourceInjectiveDirectImageIso [def-weil-pbc-strict-local-injective-source-comparison]. Define $b_i$ as the degreewise base section restriction, localized and transported by $r$, in [lem-weil-pbc-strict-local-localized-hom-germ]. Let $m$ be the global-sections homology map of the derived mate and $T$ its exact-sections/Leray target isomorphism [def-weil-pbc-strict-local-mate-projection-data]. Let $u_i:H^n(L(V_i))\cong H^n\Gamma(D_i,t_i^{-1}M)$ be homology of sourceStageSectionsIso followed by the inverse localization/homology factorization [def-weil-pbc-strict-local-injective-source-comparison]. Let $r_i$ be termwiseSectionsRestriction along the triangle $p=a_i t_i$, and $c_p$ representativeSectionsComparison [lem-weil-pbc-injective-sections-pullback-comparison]. Then $b_i m T=u_i r_i c_p$ for every $i$. This equality concerns sections of a complex; it has no localized Hom class or canonical derived cohomology germ map.

proof.text: Apply the derived mate sections factorization to f,s,K,n,J,q,i. This replaces the derived mate composite by homology of the degreewise underived sections map followed by localization and representativeSectionsComparison.

Rewrite the underived sections transformation by its cone restriction formula. Mapping the transformation to complexes gives the composite a≫b: a is the degreewise sourceStageSectionsIso and b is the section restriction chain map defining termwiseSectionsRestriction. Verify this chain-map equality degreewise. Apply functoriality of homology.

Apply naturality of (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctorFactors AddCommGrpCat n).inv to b, compose on the left by H^n(a), and on the right by representativeSectionsComparison. This moves the inverse localization comparison before the homology map of Q(b), which is termwiseSectionsRestriction. Associativity yields the unchanged statement.

theorem strictLocalComplexSectionRestriction_mate {X S : Scheme.{v}}
    (f : X ⟶ S)
    {Ω : Type v} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ S)
    (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}))
    (n : ℤ) (Q : StrictLocalNeighbourhoodGeometry f s)
    (J : CochainComplex.Plus (InjectiveObject
      (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})))
    (q : K.obj ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj
      (((InjectiveObject.ι _).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj J.obj)) :
    ∀ i : SmallModel.{v} (Scheme.strictHenselizationNeighbourhoods s),
    let M := ((InjectiveObject.ι _).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj J.obj
    let L := ((lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj M
    strictLocalComplexSectionRestriction s
      ((rightDerivedLowerStarPlus AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} f).obj K) L
      (sourceInjectiveDirectImageIso f K J q) n i ≫
        ((Sheaf.Γ (Scheme.strictHenselizationScheme s).smallEtaleTopology
        AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}).map
        ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ n).map
          ((mateEquiv (upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} f).derivedPlus
            (upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}
              (pullback.snd f (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap s))).derivedPlus
            (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ (pullbackSquareComparison AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}
              (IsPullback.of_hasPullback f
                (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap s)).toCommSq).hom))
                |>.natTrans.app K))) ≫
        (strictLocalBaseChangeTargetIso f s K n).hom =
    (HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (.up ℤ) n).map
      ((NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex (sourceStageSectionsIso f s i) (.up ℤ)).hom.app M) ≫
    (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctorFactors AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} n).inv.app _ ≫
    termwiseSectionsRestriction (Q.legs.app i)
      ((strictLocalNeighbourhoodProjection f s).app i)
      (pullback.fst f (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap s)) (Q.over i).symm M n ≫
    representativeSectionsComparison
      (pullback.fst f (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap s)) q n
